ticket.panelDescription:
# 🎫 Frontier Support
## Official Support Desk
-# Select the closest support path below. Frontier staff will handle your request in a private ticket.

### Available Support
- **💬 General Support:** questions, account help, or general server support.
- **🎖️ Rank Request:** Discord rank or role review.
- **🛡️ Player Report:** report player conduct with evidence.
- **🛠️ Bug Report:** report bot/server/gameplay issues.
- **💛 Donation Support:** donation questions and purchase help.
